rationale: The tool log shows the agent looked up two emails, retrieved a user profile and several orders, then executed cancellations and returns (including selecting a gift card refund method). There is no evidence of user authentication beyond email lookup, no explicit confirmation from the user prior to each order-changing write, and no clear final summary of actions or outcomes. Policy requires authenticating the user and confirming every order-changing action before proceeding. Without evidence of these steps, and with order-altering calls executed, the interaction does not meet the stated policy despite performing some of the requested actions.
